items.title: Well-formed Content-Length control
items.context: An isolated route before any desync probe
items.intended_use: Measure normal framing, timing, keep-alive, and follow-up behavior
items.payload:
POST /isolated-canary HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Content-Length: 4

q=1
caveats: This is a normal control, not a smuggling payload
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Ambiguous framing review gate
items.context: Explicitly approved isolated desync test window
items.intended_use: Require topology, controls, monitoring, and stop conditions before payload construction
items.payload: REVIEW-ONLY: owner-designed canary pair for the confirmed hop topology
caveats: No ready-to-run CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE, H2.CL, or H2.TE payload is provided

items.title: Queue confirmation marker
items.context: A dedicated route/client after an anomaly is observed
items.intended_use: Distinguish an assessor-only queue effect from retries/cache/load balancing
caveats: Never place the marker into shared-user requests or cache keys
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
